summary: The root نَصَتَ (naṣata) means to be silent, often with the intention of listening. It can also mean to listen attentively.
lane: 1 نَصَتَ ذ , aor. نَصِبَ , (L, K,) inf. n. نَصْتٌ ; (L;) and , inf. n. إِنْصَاتٌ , (S, L, K) which latter is the more approved; (L;) and ; (L, K;) He was silent: (L, K:) or he was silent and listened: (S:) or he was silent to listen: (L:) or he was silent as one listening: (Er-Rághib:) or he listened: (Msb:) or انتصب signifies he stood, or paused, listening. (Msb.) -b2- , and انصت لَهُ , (S, K,) and إِلَيْهِ , (Z,) and نَصَتَ لَهُ , (L,) He was silent, and listened to his speech. (S, K, &c.)
